items.summary: rpg-toolkit/tools/spatial and tools/environments — spatial and dungeon graph
items.details: go.mod: tools/spatial v0.4.0, tools/environments v0.4.0. spatial owns the hex-grid room type and entity placement. environments owns the connection graph (rooms + edges) used for dungeon layouts.

go.mod has no replace directives. Per workspace CLAUDE.md: NEVER add replace directives — they break CI/CD. During development that needs unreleased toolkit features, publish to the toolkit repo and update the version.
go.mod: github.com/testcontainers/testcontainers-go v0.40.0 and modules/redis v0.40.0. Used by the integration test harness to spin up a real Redis container. Requires Docker for integration tests.
go.mod: go.uber.org/mock v0.6.0. This is Uber's maintained fork of gomock. All mocks are generated with this version. mockery is NOT used.

go.mod: github.com/KirkDiggler/rpg-toolkit/encounter v0.2.0. Released package; not a pseudo-version. Provides:
  - encounter.Broker over a pluggable Transport (NewInMemoryTransport for now)
  - encounter.Encounter aggregate with Move() and OpenDoor() verbs (more verbs coming)
  - encounter.LoadFromData(*Data, *Broker) → *Encounter
  - encounter.Encounter.ToData() → *Data (round-trips losslessly)
  - encounter.Encounter.SnapshotFor(playerID) → Snapshot (per-viewer projection)
  - encounter/core: PlayerID, EncounterID, Hex, type aliases used at the boundary
  - encounter/events: sealed EncounterEvent interface + concretes (MoveEvent, HexRevealedEvent, EntityAppearedEvent, EntityDisappearedEvent)

To update: GOPROXY=direct go get github.com/KirkDiggler/rpg-toolkit/encounter@latest. Watch for new event types — TranslateEvent in v2/encounter/translate.go must add a case for each, otherwise the stream loop logs ErrUnknownEventType in production.
